Add edge case test suite in test/test_edge_cases.c following TEST() macro pattern from test_nur.c: test integer overflow in error construction (INT_MAX line numbers, overflow in timer arithmetic), NULL pointer safety (all public functions gracefully handle NULL), boundary conditions (zero-size allocations, empty strings, max error code values), error code taxonomy boundaries (codes at 9/10, 19/20, 29/30, 39/40, 49/50, 59/60 ranges), macro parameter edge cases (empty expressions, nested macro calls, side effects)

Add stress test suite in test/test_stress.c: deep recursion test (100+ levels of NUR_TRY_TO propagation to verify stack safety), large allocation test (allocate/free 1000 pointers via nur_malloc/free), rapid Result creation/destruction (1M Result objects created and checked), error message stress (very long error messages >1KB), repeated errno capture (verify errno snapshot correctness across 10K iterations)

Add thread safety test suite in test/test_thread_safety.c (conditional on pthread or C11 threads.h availability): concurrent Result construction from multiple threads (verify no data races), concurrent error printing to different FILE streams, errno capture race test (multiple threads setting errno and capturing via NUR_ERROR_ERRNO simultaneously - each must capture its own errno), verify zero global mutable state guarantee

Update Makefile to add new test targets: test-edge-cases, test-stress, test-thread-safety (with pthread linkage if available), test-coverage (gcc --coverage flags, gcov report generation showing 100% line coverage goal), test-standards-compliance (explicitly compile with -std=c99, -std=c11, -std=c17, -std=c23 and verify no errors/warnings)

Add memory leak test script in test/run_valgrind_suite.sh (bash) and test/run_valgrind_suite.ps1 (PowerShell): run all test binaries under Valgrind with --leak-check=full --error-exitcode=1, verify zero leaks, zero errors, parse Valgrind output for summary statistics

Create test/test_all.sh and test/test_all.ps1 comprehensive test runner scripts: execute make test-all, make test-edge-cases, make test-stress, make test-thread-safety, make test-valgrind (if available), make test-c23-features, collect results, generate pass/fail summary with total coverage percentage

Document test coverage in test/TESTING.md: describe each test suite purpose, how to run individual suites, interpreting results, coverage metrics achieved (target: 100% lines, 95%+ branches, all macros exercised), adding new tests (follow TEST() pattern, return 1=pass/0=fail/-1=skip)
